$comment: Agency defaults, derived from ONE recorded client. Treat as editable policy, not truth.
Each entry is listed in PLAN.md section 7 for confirmation.
quote  - values merged INTO the QuoteRequest (must match its shape)
policy - how the agent behaves; never merged into the quote
Client data (credit authorisation, years with carrier, dwelling values, occupation,
number of residents) is NOT here and must come from the input JSON.

effectiveDate.$comment: How to pick the new-policy effective date when the input does not supply a future one.

icq.$comment: Selector-keyed ICQ answers observed as agency-standard. Labels are useless here, so these are keyed by selector and merged into carrierAnswers.
